value.value: Use primitive cell models based on reported cubic and rhombohedral structures; determine most stable magnetic state then bands. HSE06 and zero-order regular approximation treat scalar relativity. Γ-centered k meshes are 6×6×6 for cubic and 3×3×3 for rhombohedral. No computed state is a direct measured nanocrystal configuration.

value.value: The cubic CB edge has dispersed Mn4s character, yielding indirect5.18 eV and direct5.37 eV gaps. The rhombohedral system is direct; Figure5c marks Γ states at5.35 and5.37 eV. VB character includes Cl3p/Mn3d with dx2-y2 and dz2; model symmetry/spin restrictions are proposed to explain nonemissive cubic versus emissive rhombohedral behavior.
